from solution import all_unique


def test_issue_example_integers_unique():
    """Example asserts all_unique([1,2,3]) == True."""
    expected = True  # total=3, distinct=3, 3-3=0 duplicates => True
    result = all_unique([1, 2, 3])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_empty_list_unique():
    """Empty list has no repeats so elements are unique."""
    expected = True  # total=0, distinct=0, 0-0=0 duplicates => True
    result = all_unique([])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_element_unique():
    """Single element list has unique elements."""
    expected = True  # total=1, distinct=1, 1-1=0 duplicates => True
    result = all_unique([7])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_adjacent_duplicate_not_unique():
    """List [1,1] is not unique because an element repeats."""
    expected = False  # total=2, distinct=1, 2-1=1 duplicate => False
    result = all_unique([1, 1])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_nonadjacent_duplicate_not_unique():
    """List [1,2,3,1] is not unique due to non-adjacent repeat."""
    expected = False  # total=4, distinct=3, 4-3=1 duplicate => False
    result = all_unique([1, 2, 3, 1])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_all_same_not_unique():
    """List [0,0,0] is not unique because all elements repeat."""
    expected = False  # total=3, distinct=1, 3-1=2 duplicates => False
    result = all_unique([0, 0, 0])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_unique_strings():
    """String list ['a','b','c'] has unique elements."""
    expected = True  # total=3, distinct=3, 3-3=0 duplicates => True
    result = all_unique(["a", "b", "c"])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_duplicate_strings():
    """String list ['a','b','a'] is not unique due to repeat."""
    expected = False  # total=3, distinct=2, 3-2=1 duplicate => False
    result = all_unique(["a", "b", "a"])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_mixed_types_unique():
    """Mixed list [1,'a',None] has unique elements."""
    expected = True  # total=3, distinct=3, 3-3=0 duplicates => True
    result = all_unique([1, "a", None])
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_duplicate_none_not_unique():
    """List [None,0,None] is not unique due to repeated None."""
    expected = False  # total=3, distinct=2, 3-2=1 duplicate => False
    result = all_unique([None, 0, None])
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_returns_bool_when_true():
    """Result for unique list must equal True as bool type."""
    expected = True  # total=2, distinct=2, 2-2=0 duplicates => True
    result = all_unique([1, 2])
    assert (isinstance(result, bool)) == expected


def test_contract_returns_bool_when_false():
    """Result for duplicate list must equal False as bool type."""
    expected = True  # check=1, match=1, 1-1=0 => True for isinstance
    result = all_unique([1, 1])
    assert (isinstance(result, bool)) == expected
